scope: Public read-only Mashhad urban bus arrivals; no UI/timing changes, deployment, restarts, credentials, APK downloads, CAPTCHA bypass, or proxy configuration changes.
conclusion: Neshan officially advertises Mashhad bus arrivals. A discovered indexed Neshan terminal page contains minute-valued route entries, but live origin requests returned browser-check HTML, so no live ETA response or reusable anonymous arrival API was verified. Published developer APIs reviewed are not bus arrival APIs. Municipal map portal was unreachable from both tested paths. Partnership/access enquiries are the credible integration route.

gtfs.meaning: No publicly documented first-party Mashhad GTFS or GTFS-RT URL discovered in this bounded research, not proof none exists. Generic directories and train tracker claims were not accepted as official feed evidence.

next_test_with_owner_link: Open exactly the supplied URL in named browser session bus-arrivals-research; record redirect chain, resolved stop/place ID and coordinates.

If normal public access succeeds without login/challenge bypass, inspect the rendered arrival section and only public requests made by that page. Record endpoint, method, status, schema, timestamp, cache headers, line/direction/stop IDs and access requirement without copying session credentials.
Repeat twice at a modest interval during Mashhad service hours, looking for actual feed freshness and changing ETA; this run does not establish service-hours functionality.

If only app/deep link, authentication or browser verification is offered, stop there. Ask owner for a screenshot with stop code as a comparison aid, not app credentials; ask Neshan/municipality/Podium for approved integration access.
Do not interpret an indexed minute value, ordinary road travel time, public place hash, or HTTP 200 challenge as a successful live-arrival API.
retrieval_issue: Configured OpenAI-native web search/extract backend could not directly extract pages. Search tool fell back to keenable/exa and those responses are explicitly index evidence; origin evidence uses curl. No tool configuration changed.
